Title:
General Weather Complete Pack - 2D Weather VFX + Bonus SFX

Short description:
A complete 2D weather pack with animated rain, snow, fog, ash, wind, clouds, lightning and bonus weather sound effects.

Price:
$5.00

Classification:
Graphical Assets

Description:
General Weather Complete Pack is a ready-to-use 2D weather asset pack for game developers.

It includes animated weather VFX as transparent PNG frame sequences and spritesheets, plus a bonus SFX pack with WAV weather loops and natural thunder one-shots.

Designed for 2D platformers, metroidvania games, RPGs, side-scrollers and atmospheric indie games.

Features:
- Rain: light, medium and heavy
- Snow: light, medium and heavy
- Fog: low fog and deep fog
- Ash drifting effect
- Wind gust overlay
- White cloud layers
- Sharp white and cyan lightning bolts
- Lightning flash overlays
- Transparent PNG frames
- Spritesheets included
- GIF previews included
- Bonus weather SFX included
- WAV rain, snow, fog, wind, ash and cloud loops
- Natural thunder one-shots
- Commercial use license

Beginner note:
These are animated weather overlays.
They are not tilemaps, characters or backgrounds by themselves.
Place them as transparent animated layers over your game scene.

Tags:
2D, Pixel Art, Weather, VFX, SFX, Rain, Snow, Fog, Clouds, Lightning, Thunder, Storm, Game Assets, Sprites, Animation, Platformer, Metroidvania, Unity, Godot, GameMaker, LDtk

AI Disclosure:
Some visual and audio assets were created with procedural and AI-assisted workflows, then edited, validated and packaged manually.
